# cJSON 1.7.19

Unmodified source and header from
https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON/tree/v1.7.19, with the upstream MIT license
in `LICENSE`. The build sets `CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT=32`. Config validation adds
strict JSON numeric syntax, duplicate-key rejection and schema checks.
